identity.name: NLC INDIA LIMITED
identity.industry: Lignite/Coal-fired Power Generation + Captive Mining transitioning to Renewables/Storage (regulated utility + merchant coal)

summary.oneLiner: A Navratna lignite-power-and-mining PSU executing a credible, balance-sheet-backed pivot to 10 GW renewables + storage by 2030 while monetising captive coal via merchant e-auction and unlocking value through NIRL listing — but near-term reported PAT growth is flattered by ~₹1,200 cr of one-off tax/regulatory items that reverse next year.

one-line thesis: A Navratna lignite-power-and-mining PSU executing a credible, balance-sheet-backed pivot to 10 GW renewables + storage by 2030 while monetising captive coal via merchant e-auction and unlocking value through NIRL listing — but near-term reported PAT growth is flattered by ~₹1,200 cr of one-off tax/regulatory items that reverse next year.
financial scorecard:
| Metric (Consolidated, FY26) | FY26 | FY25 | YoY |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue from operations | ₹17,490 cr | ₹15,283 cr | +14.4% |
| EBITDA | ₹7,475 cr | ₹6,513 cr | +14.8% |
| EBIT | ₹5,097 cr | — | — |
| PAT | ₹3,769 cr | ₹2,714 cr | +38.9% |
| Net worth | ₹21,525 cr | ₹18,723 cr | +15.0% |
| EPS | ₹25.40 | — | +33.3% |
| Net margin / Op. margin | ~20% / >22% | — | — |

| Metric (Standalone, FY26) | FY26 | FY25 | YoY |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | ₹10,864 cr | ₹10,286 cr | +5.6% |
| EBITDA | ₹5,006 cr | ₹4,788 cr | +4.5% |
| PAT | ₹2,525 cr | ₹1,900 cr | +32.9% |
| Net worth | ₹19,270 cr | ₹17,465 cr | +10.3% |
| Coal production (Talabira+) | 19.14 MMT | 17.20 MMT | +11.3% |

**Key operating metrics:** Group gross generation 28.95 BU (RE 2.26 BU, all-time high); coal dispatch 17.69 MMT; merchant e-auction 12+ MMT (vs 7.3 MMT) at avg ₹898/t (Talabira); collection efficiency 100%; FY26 Capex ₹9,131 cr (all-time high).

**One-offs / quality flags (material):** Tax rate ~1% in FY26 due to (a) 80-IA reversals at NTPL (~₹800 cr) and (b) tax advantage on RE asset transfer NLCIL→NIRL (~₹500 cr) → combined ~₹1,200 cr that will NOT recur. PBT≈PAT this year for the same reason. Additionally, **net regulatory income jumped from ~₹20-30 cr (FY25) to ~₹900 cr (FY26)** on favourable tariff orders — accrual-based, cash expected within 6 months; some (but not ₹900 cr) recurs in FY27. Adjusting for these, underlying PAT growth is far softer than headline +39%.
guidance (next quarter / forward — verif:
- **No quarterly guidance given** (this was an annual Investor Day, not a quarterly call).
- **FY27 revenue target ~₹25,300 cr** (analyst-cited; mgmt confirmed driven by ~1 GW solar adds + Ghatampur Unit III + Pachwara ramp).
- **FY27 coal: 22 MMT** (Talabira 20 MMT + Pachwara 2 MMT).
- **FY27 Capex plan ₹19,722 cr (power)**; incl. JVs ₹23,600 cr total (power ₹19,722 cr + mining ₹1,490 cr + RE/diversification ₹2,388 cr). [Note: FY26 Capex ₹9,131 cr missed the ₹16,000 cr earlier guidance.]
- **Tax normalises to ~25% from FY27/FY28** ("next year it will be normal").
- **By 2030:** Revenue >₹37,000 cr, PAT >₹5,000 cr, assets >₹1.5 lakh cr, EBITDA margin ~50%; thermal >10 GW, RE >10 GW (50:50 mix vs current 77:23 thermal:RE), lignite+coal 104 MMT.
order book & pipeline:
- **Renewables:** Operational 1,734 MW; under implementation 5,810 MW (2.5 GW under construction, rest in development). ~2 GW of RE tenders won in last 6 months. Additional ~4 GW via JV mode (Rajasthan, Assam, others). RE asset base ~₹38,000 cr (5,881 MW solar+wind).
- **Storage:** BESS pipeline ~2,800 MWh — TN 500 MWh (PPA signed w/ TANGEDCO, ₹700 cr), SECI 600 MW + 1,800 MWh (LOA received via NIRL, PPA pending), Punjab 500 MWh (sole bidder, LOI pending). Pumped storage 750 MW Odisha (DPR under prep).
- **Mining:** Pachwara South (9 MMT) commenced Mar-2026; Patrapara South (in-principle MoC approval); Machhakata revised OC (CCO approval). Upcoming: Neyveli Mine-III, Gurha, Bithnok (Rajasthan), North Dhadu (Jharkhand).
- **Thermal:** Ghatampur Unit III COD imminent (→1,980 MW full station); Odisha TPS Phase-1 2,400 MW (site activity started, target Feb-2031); Talabira thermal 3×800 MW; TPS-II expansion + Rajasthan 375 MW tenders in process.
segment / subsidiary:
- **Segment EBITDA FY26:** Mining ₹2,030 cr · Thermal ₹1,393 cr · Renewables ₹492 cr. (RE revenue ₹726 cr from operational assets.)
- **NIRL:** 7 operational RE assets (1.4 GW) transferred from NLCIL; GoI approved listing via fresh issue + disinvestment of 25% of NLCIL's stake (domestic IPO route). Highest credit rating received.
- **NUPPL (Ghatampur):** regulated equity ₹3,298 cr; total project cost ~₹21,800 cr; equity fully contributed, loan not yet drawn; full capitalisation pending Unit III.
- **NTPL (Tuticorin 2×500 MW):** regulated equity ~₹1,700 cr; offtakes 3.5-4 MMT coal from Talabira.
growth verticals / optionality:
- **Critical minerals:** 2 blocks in Chhattisgarh won — Semhardih (428 MMT limestone + ~4 MMT phosphorite) and Raipura (170 MMT limestone + ~15 MMT phosphorite) at 6% revenue-share premium; India ~95% import-dependent for phosphorite. Currently G3 stage (need G2/G1 before production); exploration cost only ₹15-20 cr/block; target 1 MMT critical mineral ore by 2030 but mgmt flags negligible revenue by 2030. ISM Dhanbad tie-up for ore processing tech.
- **Nuclear:** JV with NPCIL for 700 MW (aligned to GoI 100 GW nuclear-by-2047 mission); site TBD.
- **R&D optionality (early-stage, watch):** carbon capture & sequestration pilot w/ IIT Chennai; **lignite-to-semiconductor-wafer** project in final study stage (encouraging Phase-1 results); lignite-to-humic-acid patent; coal/lignite gasification; green hydrogen 4 MW pilot at Neyveli; OB-to-sand; EV charging (expanding to commercial mode).
margins & cost dynamics:
- Returns by segment (post-tax): Thermal ~15.5%, Mining ~14%, Renewables/BESS target ~12-14% (min 14% ROE target on RE). All new business decisions screened at >12% ROI.
- **Employee cost down** — headcount cut from 35,000+ to <10,000 via SAP/automation; productivity 18.5 t lignite/manshift, 37,200 kWh thermal.
- **Interest savings ~₹1,200 cr** in FY26 from loan rationalisation + €100m KFW green loan (below domestic rates). Non-regulated equity exposed to rate risk; mgmt mitigating via soft loans.
- **Solar CUF improving:** legacy ~18-19% → new Khavda/Rajasthan plants 32-33% (bifacial + trackers); RE bid at 80:20 D:E vs thermal 70:30 (CERC).
- **8th Pay Commission:** no near-term impact (applies to PSUs only years after central govt implementation).
capex / expansion:
- FY26 Capex ₹9,131 cr (all-time high but below ₹16,000 cr guidance). FY27 plan ₹19,722 cr power / ₹23,600 cr incl. JVs.
- Capex mix to 2030: thermal 10 GW + RE 10 GW (50:50). Regulated-equity target ~₹30,000 cr by 2030 (regulated ₹19,000 cr + non-regulated ₹10,000 cr; mines >₹5,000 cr, thermal >₹14,000 cr, RE ~₹10,000 cr equity).
- Pachwara Capex ₹2,243 cr.
capital allocation:
- FY26 dividend 38.5% total (interim ₹3.60 + final ₹0.25/share). Consistent dividends 26 yrs, profits 48 yrs.
- D:E 1.29 (headroom to 2.33) — explicit balance-sheet capacity for further Capex. ROCE ~10%. Capital employed ₹52,000 cr; total assets ₹65,202 cr. GoI holding 72.2%.
- **Value unlock:** NIRL listing (25% NLCIL stake disinvestment); asset monetisation via RE transfer to NIRL.
risks & watch-items:
- **One-off-flattered earnings:** ~₹1,200 cr tax benefit + ~₹900 cr regulatory income inflate FY26 PAT; tax normalises to 25% next year → reported PAT growth decelerates sharply.
- **Going-concern flag on Neyveli mines** raised by auditors (land/Paravanar river diversion legacy issues) — mgmt says resolved since May-2023, no current generation loss, remaining land near solution.
- **Fixed-cost under-recovery** ₹865 cr FY26 (vs ₹822 cr; recovery 86% vs 82%) — concentrated in TPS-II/TPS-II expansion; mgmt targets ~half in H1 FY27, ~zero by year-end after boiler modifications (Unit I generation tripled to ~1,000 MU after retrofit).
- **PAT-vs-EBITDA divergence:** EBITDA ~2-2.5x by 2030 but PAT only +30-45% as RE returns (~12-13%) dilute thermal (~15%) and interest/depreciation rise.
- **Capex execution slippage** (FY26 missed guidance materially); merchant coal price softness (₹987/t vs ₹1,046/t).
- **Demand cyclicality:** units were under reserve shutdown ~1 month before the call before a recent demand surge.
management quality / tone: Confident, granular and command-of-detail tone; CMD answered nearly all questions with specific figures (segment EBITDA, regulated equity, under-recovery). Notably candid on negatives — proactively disclosed the going-concern flag, the ₹1,200 cr non-recurring tax benefit, fixed-cost under-recovery and the Capex miss rather than deflecting. Platinum Jubilee (70 yrs) framing. Tone = steady PSU execution with genuine transformation ambition, not hype.
non-obvious takeaways:
- The headline +39% consol PAT is substantially non-recurring; "clean" FY26 PAT is closer to ~₹2,500 cr group level after stripping ~₹1,200 cr tax + portion of ₹900 cr regulatory — important for FY27 modelling where tax normalises.
- **NIRL IPO is the real near-term value-unlock catalyst** (25% stake disinvestment, fresh issue), separating a high-growth RE platform from the regulated parent.
- TPS-II boiler retrofit (Unit I generation 300 MU → ~1,000 MU) is a quiet but high-ROI fix that could eliminate ₹865 cr under-recovery — a structural margin lever the market may underappreciate.
- Lignite-to-semiconductor-wafer R&D is a genuine optionality oddity (final study stage) — non-priced, lottery-ticket upside.
- Pachwara is G10/G11 high-grade coal with ~3 MMT/yr merchant surplus once at peak — a captive-margin coal annuity until Talabira thermal commissions ~FY31.
- Critical minerals are 5+ years from revenue (G3 stage, processing tech immature) — narrative optionality, not a 2030 numbers driver.

themes.title: Power generation & utilities - baseload + new capacity
themes.need: Record peak demand and a thermal+hydro+nuclear capacity-addition cycle underpin regulated and merchant generators plus their service chain.
